newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends up vs dlr, yen futures busy.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends up vs dlr, yen futures busy.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed slightly firmer against the dollar in average turnover on Tuesday as the mark gained against the U.S. unit in the afternoon, dealers said.
The forint finished at 160.25/35, up from 160.30/35 at midday.
The forint remained some 50 fillers weaker than the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level (bid).
"I think this differential will remain until the end of this year," said Creditanstalt's Miklos Rabl.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5-percent wide intervention band, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.
Trading in the foreign currency futures section of the Budapest Commodity Exchange was dominated by easing yen futures.
Mark futures remained steady for almost all maturities, while dollar maturities firmed or were unchanged.
